{"notes": "Visit 2 (ended 2:30). Picture: one unbroken dark chain of about 30 dominoes from START at upper right, dipping to about (21.5, 7.7) and rising to about (12.5, 4.5). No pale or disconnected dominoes, no visible breaks. Progress is good, but I can't tell who placed which. The chain is only the top line so far; nose and bottom line aren't built.

Priya: Keeps steering. She said she's working toward the nose, re-split the bottom-line work, and at 2:15 clarified that the bottom line hangs off the nose so Maya can't start until her line arrives. She also asked Leo to watch the tail bend and invited shouts about breaks. Strong leadership and communication. Small flaw: at 1:45 she told Tom to keep going on the bottom line, which contradicts the dependency she explained later. Probably the top line is hers, but unconfirmed.

Tom: Said he'd stay off the bottom line to avoid bumping Maya, is checking joins, and will look at the nose when Priya arrives. Collaborative, careful about overlap. His claim that Maya is on the bottom line is unverified and likely premature given Priya's nose dependency. Still unclear what he physically built.

Leo: Silent this visit; only task is Priya's request to watch the tail bend. The chain looks clean there, but I can't credit him. Last visit's good systems thinking stands. Need to see whether he actually checks joins.

Maya: Still nothing heard or seen from her over two visits. She may be waiting legitimately for the nose. Don't rate her down on absence alone. Ask her directly next visit what she's done and if she's blocked, and check whether she prepared anything for the bottom line while waiting.

Next: watch the nose join, whether Maya starts, and who fixes any break."}
